caption: The drawing contains four distinct objects and one animal depicted in colored pencil or watercolor on a neutral beige background. Three of the objects are shown in isolation and are rendered in shades of brown and tan, with clear wood grain texture, nails, and angular joints. The objects appear to be wooden pack saddles, shown from different angles: one viewed from above, one from the side, and one from the bottom. Each has two X-shaped wooden frames joined together on a curved wooden base. Metal bolts or supports are visible on some joints. Below these, there is a detailed drawing of a gray donkey seen in profile facing left. The donkey is fitted with one of the wooden pack saddles, complete with straps or ropes securing the saddle to its body. The drawing is composed in a vertical layout, with the isolated pack saddles at the top and the saddled donkey at the bottom.
title: Unrigged Pack Saddle
